'''Croi Makin''' is an [[Andoran]] [[Warder]] to [[Myrelle Berengari]]. 

== Appearance ==
He was a yellow-haired young splinter of stone with a fine profile. He was the only one of Myrelle's Warders who had not been bonded to another Aes Sedai. Rumor said that Myrelle was married to her first three Warders; Croi Makin, [[Nuhel Dromand]] and [[Avar Hachami]]. {{Ref|{{twotc}}, Croi Makin}}

== Activities ==
He is present when [[Egwene al'Vere]] is dressing down Myrelle for hiding [[Lan Mandragoran]] in [[Salidar]]. He is on edge watching Lan practice with the sword and picking up Myrelle's somber mood.
